# Support for Beinn

Welcome to the Beinn support documentation. If you encounter any issues while setting up the platform, developing new features, or deploying to production, this guide will help you find the right resources.

## Where to get help

### 1. Issue Tracker
For bugs, feature requests, and architectural discussions, please use our GitHub Issue Tracker. Before creating a new issue, please search existing open and closed issues to avoid duplicates.

### 2. Discussions
For general questions about the Flutter frontend or NestJS backend, join the GitHub Discussions tab. This is the best place to ask "How do I...?" questions.

### 3. Community Channels
- **Discord:** Join the Beinn Developer Discord server for real-time chat with other contributors.
- **Stack Overflow:** Ask questions using the `beinn-platform` tag.

## Reporting a Bug
When reporting a bug, please include:
- A clear and descriptive title.
- Steps to reproduce the issue.
- Expected behavior vs actual behavior.
- Environment details (Flutter version, Node.js version, OS).
- Relevant logs from the NestJS server or Flutter console.

## Security Vulnerabilities
If you discover a security vulnerability, please do NOT open a public issue. Refer to our [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) file for instructions on how to responsibly disclose the issue.
